disposition: APPROVED: smallest root-cause correction and 72 executed synthetic/integration controls independently accepted. Fresh hosted macOS native execution remains unverified.

baseline.qualification: Acceptance binds only the two target file hashes plus the unchanged surrounding implementations, not other concurrent changes. Test receipt records its exact dirty-source manifest.

original_evidence.observed: Apple prepare constructs its backend successfully, then fails in prepare -> lifetimes -> _basic; build and app launch are not reached. The old error has no PID/size/errno.
original_evidence.limit: Foreign-UID EPERM is proven reachable from reviewed source; this log cannot establish the exact old offending PID/errno, and this reviewer does not invent it.

source_proof: Old inventory proc_listallpids includes foreign-UID processes. lifetimes/snapshot invoke full PROC_PIDTBSDINFO=3 before info.uid can filter. Apple XNU leaves that flavor subject to CHECK_SAME_USER; ordinary foreign-UID access returns EPERM, libproc returns size 0, and _basic throws.

New _pids uses public proc_listpids(PROC_UID_ONLY=4, os.geteuid(), buffer, byte_capacity). Pinned public source checks effective UID during enumeration, before the privileged BSD call. proc_listpids returns bytes; its old convenience wrapper divided by sizeof(int).

Allocation has 4097 PID slots. Returned byte count must describe 1..4096 whole ints; negative/zero/unaligned/over-limit/full-allocation results fail closed. Negative or duplicate PID records fail; self and kernel PID0 remain excluded. Valid self-only inventory produces no workers, not an error.

All later UID, baseline lifetime, start boundary, exact executable, runner tracking marker, native audit token and audit-token-bound signal checks remain intact. No EPERM/EACCES broad suppression, escalation, PID fallback, or global scan was introduced.
New diagnostics capture errno immediately and include numeric identity/size data only. They do not serialize process names, argv, environments, runner markers or player secrets.
counter_evidence: Disappearing processes still map only ESRCH/ENOENT to absent, with zombie status separately recognized. Permission errors for selected same-UID candidates remain hard failures propagated to cleanup.
PROC_UID_ONLY is effective UID, not real UID. Existing own-process capability/read/claim checks reject differing real/effective identities; this does not add privileged/setuid support.

UID can change after kernel selection; later UID checks remain, and any denied privileged record still fails closed. Known admitted worker generations are re-opened and quarantined on changed identity.
A public short BSD-info scan was considered but needlessly adds a second per-process call and is not used instead of the full required start/audit identity.
The API/layout worked for the backend self-check in original CI, countering a universal ABI failure. Exact foreign-PID failure was not logged; numeric diagnostics now preserve distinction.
Mock native library tests establish ctypes argument units, callback-buffer behavior and policy, not actual XNU privilege, task marker inheritance, simulator shutdown or iOS runtime.

regression_evidence.interpretation: 50 Apple tests use synthetic native/simulator boundaries; two of the additional 22 general controls use real isolated Git and a fake owned wrapper subprocess. No real native process signal or simulator execution is claimed.

references.claim: Public ABI; bytes versus proc_listallpids PID count.
Selectors 4 effective/5 real UID; full BSD flavor3.
Kernel UID filtering and copied-byte units; privileged full-record ordering.

research.version_limit: macOS15 first-release public XNU source; exact macOS15.7.9/24G830 hosted patch kernel is not established. Native hosted proof is still required.

cleanup.reviewer_activity: Read/hash/AST/report only. No build, native execution, worker, simulator, signal, source deletion or Git mutation started by this reviewer; no cleanup performed on other lanes.

remaining_gates.gate: Fresh hosted macOS15/Xcode26.3 Apple preparation, runtime/linkage and scoped finalizer
remaining_gates.reason: This acceptance only has executed local controls and source proof. A later hosted run must requalify the actual OS/worker environment.

compatibility: CI-only implementation/test change. No game, protocol4.2, persistence, content, app identity, signing, publication policy or production UI change.
